integrity: The analytic proof and independent transfer-matrix diagnostic are included; finite diagnostics are not infinite proofs. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Constant symmetric speed, independent Poisson sign flips, fixed initial positive velocity, and immediate absorption at two endpoints; conditional reversal counts, not first-passage times. All novelty claims are provisional pending independent literature assessment.
title: Two nested reversal-count fluctuation thresholds for finite-interval run-and-tumble escape
